content:
Apple has set up a waitlist for Siri AI for users testing the beta versions of its upcoming operating systems, and it looks like the same approach will be used when iOS 27 and macOS 27 launch next month.

This means that after updating to the new operating system, users won't have immediate access to the new Siri AI features...

Apple added the Siri AI waitlist to the first developer betas of iOS 27 and macOS 27, likely to gauge usage and determine how much server capacity is needed to handle AI tasks that can't run on-device.

Wait times for beta testers vary, with many reporting one to two weeks. During the wait, the Siri AI settings will simply display 'Joined Waitlist'.

It appears the waitlist will also remain in place when the new operating systems officially launch. A member on the MacRumors forums spotted code that Apple recently added to estimate how long users may have to wait.

The wait time estimate is provided by the server, meaning Apple can adjust wait times based on the balance between demand and capacity.

When approved to use these new features, users will receive a push notification.
